informational: A getaddrinfo_a submission that fails (no memory for the queue to grow, or no worker thread) takes its requests off the queue as empty slots that stay counted until a worker skips them; while memory stays short, later submissions also get EAI_MEMORY. On next this happened after any overflow of the 4096 queue (EAI_AGAIN). Follow-up: drop the failed call's requests from the ring's tail (they were pushed last, under the same lock).
gai_cancel(NULL) cancels at most 64 queued requests per call (a fixed array); not in the audit.
The probe service (~/bin/probe) takes --liella, not the README's --niji, and reports libniji products missing for this tree even after rebuilding them (20 minutes lost); probes were run by hand.
